verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents self-hosting and has an official Docker Compose deployment guide, so the Docker Compose path is covered. The pack shows no guides for the other targets the story names, so only one of the four deployment paths is evidenced. Missing for 10: Kubernetes/Helm guide, small-VPS guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, evidence that the guides are maintained, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, official deployment paths cover my target — Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, a small VPS, or a Raspberry Pi — each with its own maintained guide

citations.quote: LobeHub can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, giving you complete control over your data, customization, and deployment environment.
